sentences.text:
Guru Pado Thakur vs The State Of Jharkhand And Others on 19
August, 2021

Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi

In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 ----
W.P.(Cr.) No. 116 of 2016
----
 Guru Pado Thakur ..... Petitioner
 -- Versus --
 The State of Jharkhand and Others ...... Respondents
 ----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---
For the Petitioner :- Mr. Mukesh Kumar, Advocate For the State :- Mr. Manoj Kumar, Advocate
----
8/19.08.2021
This petition has been heard through Video Conferencing in view of the guidelines of the High Court taking into account the situation arising due to COVID-19 pandemic.
It appears that section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 provides for the provision of Appellate Tribunal where there is a provision of appeal against the Tribunal.

Mr. Manoj Kumar, the learned State counsel shall apprise the Court as to whether the said Tribunals are functioning in the State of Jharkhand or not on the next date.
Post after two weeks.
Interim order dated 12.08.2016 shall remain in force till the next date.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J) SI/
